mapper.select:
SELECT STAFF_SQ, STATUS_CD, SEQ_NO, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, STAFF_NM, RRN_ENC, PHONE, EMAIL, COMPANY_EMAIL, ADDR, STATION , JOIN_DT, LEAVE_DT, HS_NM, HS_MAJOR, HS_GRAD, HS_KIND, HS_STATE, UNIV_NM, UNIV_MAJOR, UNIV_GRAD, UNIV_KIND, UNIV_STATE, FINAL_EDU , MIL_IN_DT, MIL_OUT_DT, MIL_EXEMPT, EDU_NM, EDU_START_DT, EDU_END_DT, EDU_ORG, CERT_DT, BANK_NM, ACCOUNT_ENC , DOC_REG, DOC_ID, DOC_GRAD, DOC_BANK, DOC_PHOTO, DOC_HI, DOC_CONTRACT, DOC_BIZ, DOC_EI, DOC_SEC , DOC_EDU, DOC_NEP, DOC_PRIV, DOC_CRIME, DOC_MIL , EMG_REL1, EMG_TEL1, EMG_REL2, EMG_TEL2, PREV_CAREER, HOBBY, LANG_SKILL, SPECIALTY
, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(M.CONTENT ORDER BY M.MEMO_SQ DESC SEPARATOR '\n') FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M WHERE M.TARGET_CD = 'STAFF' AND M.TARGET_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M.STAFF_SQ) AS MEMO , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M WHERE M.TARGET_CD = 'STAFF' AND M.TARGET_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M.STAFF_SQ) AS MEMO_CNT
, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_EQP_RENT_H R WHERE R.STAFF_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M.STAFF_SQ AND R.OPEN_YN = 'Y') AS EQP_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_HR_VACATION_R V WHERE V.STAFF_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M.STAFF_SQ) AS VAC_CNT
, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT F.DOC_CD) FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_DOC_R F WHERE F.STAFF_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M.STAFF_SQ) AS DOC_FILES
, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_PRJ_R P WHERE P.STAFF_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M.STAFF_SQ AND P.DEPLOY_SQ IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(IFNULL(D.CLIENT_NM, ''), '|', IFNULL(D.PRJ_NM, ''))) FROM TB_EEP_DEPLOY_R D WHERE D.STAFF_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M.STAFF_SQ AND D.START_DT IS NOT NULL) AS PRJ_CNT , SCORE, GAPIL_YN, AUTO_APLY_YN, GRADE_NM, REAL_CAREER, WISH_PRICE, WORK_DOMAIN, WISH_LOC , ETC1, REPORT, ETC2, EXPERTISE, SK_EXTRA, EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M ORDER BY STATUS_CD DESC, JOIN_DT DESC, STAFF_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M (STATUS_CD, STAFF_NM, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, PHONE, JOIN_DT, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{STATUS_CD}, #{STAFF_NM}, NULLIF(#{ORG_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{DEPT_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{POSITION_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{PHONE}, ''), NULLIF(#{JOIN_DT}, ''), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{VALUE}) AS ACCOUNT_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{VALUE} AND STAFF_SQ <> #{STAFF_SQ}) AS TAKEN_CNT
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET SECRET_YN = #{SECRET_YN} WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET DRIVE_FOLDER_ID = #{DRIVE_FOLDER_ID} WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT DOC_SQ, STAFF_SQ, DOC_CD, FILE_ID, FILE_NM, MIME_TYPE, WEB_LINK, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DT FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_DOC_R WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} ORDER BY DOC_CD, DOC_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_DOC_R (STAFF_SQ, DOC_CD, FILE_ID, FILE_NM, MIME_TYPE, WEB_LINK, REG_EMPLY_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{STAFF_SQ}, #{DOC_CD}, #{FILE_ID}, #{FILE_NM}, #{MIME_TYPE}, #{WEB_LINK}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_DOC_R WHERE DOC_SQ = #{DOC_SQ} AND STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_SQ, STAFF_SQ, ITEM_CD, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5 FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_ITEM_R WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} ORDER BY ITEM_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_ITEM_R (STAFF_SQ, ITEM_CD, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, REG_EMPLY_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{STAFF_SQ}, #{ITEM_CD}, #{C1}, #{C2}, #{C3}, #{C4}, #{C5}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_ITEM_R SET C1 = #{C1}, C2 = #{C2}, C3 = #{C3}, C4 = #{C4}, C5 = #{C5}, UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE ITEM_SQ = #{ITEM_SQ} AND STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} AND ITEM_CD = #{ITEM_CD}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_ITEM_R WHERE ITEM_SQ = #{ITEM_SQ} AND STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT STAFF_SQ, STATUS_CD FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE TRN_SQ = #{TRN_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M (STATUS_CD, STAFF_NM, ORG_NM, PHONE, TRN_SQ, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) SELECT 'WAIT', T.TRN_NM, '교육생', I.PHONE, T.TRN_SQ, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW() FROM TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M T LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M I ON I.INTV_SQ = T.INTV_SQ WHERE T.TRN_SQ = #{TRN_SQ}T.INTV_SQ = #{INTV_SQ} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S WHERE S.TRN_SQ = T.TRN_SQ)

INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M (STATUS_CD, STAFF_NM, ORG_NM, PHONE, INTV_SQ, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) SELECT 'WAIT', I.APLY_NM, '경력직', I.PHONE, I.INTV_SQ, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW() FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M I WHERE I.INTV_SQ = #{INTV_SQ} AND I.HIRE_CD = 'EXP' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S WHERE S.INTV_SQ = I.INTV_SQ)
